dedupe_keys.name: pse transmission supply continuity indicators ens ait saidi saifi maifi for customers connected to the polish transmission grid

description: PSE publishes yearly information on the duration of interruptions in electricity supply to customers connected to the Polish transmission network. The indicators are computed for group II delivery points, where disconnection actually interrupts supply from the transmission network: as of 31 December 2025 these were 21 delivery points, 13 customers connected through a single network delivery point (5 at 110 kV, 6 at 220 kV, 2 at 400 kV) and 8 end delivery points (2 at 110 kV, 4 at 220 kV, 2 at 400 kV). Indicators are energy not supplied (ENS, MWh per year, with and without catastrophic interruptions), average interruption time (AIT, minutes per year), SAIDI and SAIFI for long and very long interruptions, and MAIFI for short interruptions, using the interruption classes of the 2023 regulation on detailed operating conditions of the power system: transient up to 1 second, short up to 3 minutes, long up to 12 hours, very long up to 24 hours and catastrophic beyond 24 hours. Values are given in tables 1 to 3, based on recorded planned and unplanned interruptions. Coverage is the Polish transmission system. The page can be exported as PDF or DOC and is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: it covers only transmission-connected delivery points, only 21 delivery points. Simulation uses are transmission reliability benchmarks and energy-not-supplied calibration. Related records: data-pse-poland-system-data lists other PSE data.
